answer: Locks are recorded in falcon, expire in oasis, and comet lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 82 aliases therefore needs 114 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 27 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4662 identities would post 537 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
